notes.zh:
本次更新：
· 出场引导换成 13 句轮播，每次登场随机两句，一天最多三次
· 退出后伙伴不会再自己回来，想找它就重新打开
· 专心模式切换更干净
· 多只伙伴说话不再重复同一句，各有各的话
· 久坐提醒的时间更准
notes.en:
What's new:
- 13 rotating lines on entry, two picked at random each time, up to 3 times a day
- Pets no longer come back by themselves after you exit
- Cleaner Focus mode switching
- Multiple buddies no longer repeat the same line, each has its own
- More accurate long-sitting reminder
